Mctt.Core.Completeness.Inductives.ViewArgs

The Arguments of a View's Constructor, Against its Container's

A view k of a valid group D views the member kc of its container Dq at the instance Is; the container's member i' is taken to the group's member v (vm), and a constructor c of both has the container's arguments gs' and the group's gs, position by position corresponding (cargs_correspond). At the group's uniform parameters ups and the instance's values cups there, with the values ms of the non-uniform parameters related at both, the semantic view equation of the arguments (valid_group_views_view_args) relates, position by position, the type of the group's argument to the container's (view_arg_link). Hence arguments related at the container's non-recursive positions, completed by fresh variables at the positions recursive in both, are related at both telescopes (view_args_complete); and at a position the container has as non-recursive and the group as recursive (the view nests through it), the container's canonical relation of the argument is the group's relation of the shape (nested_arg_rel_agree).

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.

Lemma cargs_correspond_split : forall vm gs1' gs2' gs1 gs2, cargs_correspond vm (gs1' ++ gs2') (gs1 ++ gs2) ->
    List.length gs1' = List.length gs1 -> cargs_correspond vm gs1' gs1 /\ cargs_correspond vm gs2' gs2.
Proof.
  intros vm; induction gs1' as [| g' gs1' IH]; intros gs2' gs1 gs2 H Hl; destruct gs1 as [| g gs1]; cbn in Hl; try discriminate;
    [ split; [ exact I | exact H ] |].
  destruct g' as [rA' A' | t'], g as [rA A | t]; cbn in H |- *; try contradiction.
  - destruct H as [Hr H]; destruct (IH _ _ _ H ltac:(lia)) as [H1 H2]; exact (conj (conj Hr H1) H2).
  - destruct H as [Hr H]; destruct (IH _ _ _ H ltac:(lia)) as [H1 H2]; exact (conj (conj Hr H1) H2).
  - destruct H as (Hm & Hd & H); destruct (IH _ _ _ H ltac:(lia)) as [H1 H2].
    split; [ exact (conj Hm (conj Hd H1)) | exact H2 ].
Qed.

Section ViewArgs.
  Variables (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (Hg : valid_group p D) (Hcv : containers_valid D).
  Variables (k : nat) (Mk : imember) (qc : qname) (kc : nat) (Is : list exp) (vm : list nat) (Dq : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HMk : ind_member D k = Some Mk) (Hh : im_head Mk = mh_view qc kc Is vm)
    (Hq : ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some Dq).
  Hypothesis (HcvQ : containers_valid Dq).
  Let HgQ := Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq.
  Variables (ups cups : list domain).
  Hypotheses (Hgu : per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams D)) nil nil ups ups) (Hu : List.length ups = ind_nu D)
    (Ecups : ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D ups ↘ cups).
  Variables (i' : nat) (Mi' : imember) (v : nat) (Mv : imember).
  Hypotheses (HMi' : ind_member Dq i' = Some Mi') (Hv : List.nth_error vm i' = Some v) (HMv : ind_member D v = Some Mv).
  Variables (c : String.string) (gs' gs : list carg).
  Hypotheses (Hcon' : ind_con Mi' c = Some gs') (Hcon : ind_con Mv c = Some gs) (Hcorr : cargs_correspond vm gs' gs).
  Variable (ms : list domain).
  Hypothesis (Hlms : List.length ms = im_nn Mv).

  Lemma view_container_uparams_rel : per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)) nil nil cups cups.
  Proof.
    destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_values p D Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq _ _ Hgu Hu) as (c0 & c0' & E0 & E0' & Hc0).
    pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0 Ecups) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0' Ecups) as ->.
    exact Hc0.
  Qed.

  Lemma length_container_uparams : List.length cups = ind_nu Dq.
  Proof.
    destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ Hg) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh) as (D2 & Mk' & Hl2 & _ & _ & HIl & _).
    rewrite Hq in Hl2; injection Hl2 as <-.
    rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ecups); exact HIl.
  Qed.

  Lemma view_nn : im_nn Mv = im_nn Mi'.
  Proof.
    destruct (decl_typed_view_wrap _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ Hg) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh) as (D2 & Hq2 & Hvw).
    rewrite Hq in Hq2; injection Hq2 as <-.
    destruct (view_wrap_ok_members _ _ _ Hvw _ _ _ HMi' Hv) as (Mv' & HMv' & Hnn & _).
    rewrite HMv in HMv'; injection HMv' as <-; exact Hnn.
  Qed.

The Types at a Position

At arguments vs before a position related at both telescopes, the types there have the same head PER, the container's at cups and the group's at ups; both are types, related to each other.
  Record arg_type_link (C G : typ) (Ec Eg : env) : Prop := mk_arg_type_link
    {
The two head PERs agree
      heads_agree : per_head C C Ec Ec <~> per_head G G Eg Eg
      
The group's type evaluates to a type
    ; group_type_value : exists (i : nat) R b, ⟦ G ⟧ Eg ↘ b /\ DF b ≈ b ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R /\ not_level_sort b
      
The container's type evaluates to a type
    ; container_type_value : exists (i : nat) R a, ⟦ C ⟧ Ec ↘ a /\ DF a ≈ a ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R
      
The two values are related types
    ; group_container_types_related : exists (i : nat) R b a, ⟦ G ⟧ Eg ↘ b /\ ⟦ C ⟧ Ec ↘ a /\
        DF b ≈ a ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R }.

  Lemma view_arg_link : forall gsA' g' gsB' gsA g gsB κC C κG G vs, gs' = gsA' ++ g' :: gsB' -> gs = gsA ++ g :: gsB ->
      List.length gsA = List.length gsA' -> List.length vs = List.length gsA ->
      cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' (gsA' ++ g' :: nil) = ce_ass κC C :: cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gsA' ->
      cargs_ctx p D Mv (gsA ++ g :: nil) = ce_ass κG G :: cargs_ctx p D Mv gsA ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gsA ++ im_params D Mv)) nil nil (ups ++ ms ++ vs) (ups ++ ms ++ vs) ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gsA' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) nil nil (cups ++ ms ++ vs) (cups ++ ms ++ vs) ->
      arg_type_link C G (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gsA' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) (cups ++ ms ++ vs))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gsA ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs)).

Arguments Related at Both Telescopes

Arguments vp whose values at the container's non-recursive positions are related canonically give arguments vs related at the group's telescope over ups and at the container's over cups: vs is vp at the container's non-recursive positions and a fresh variable at the positions recursive in both.
  Hypotheses (Hms_g : per_tele_args (List.rev (im_params D Mv)) nil nil (ups ++ ms) (ups ++ ms))
    (Hms_c : per_tele_args (List.rev (im_params Dq Mi')) nil nil (cups ++ ms) (cups ++ ms)).

The invariant of the walk through the arguments: after the prefixes gsA' and gsA, the arguments vs built from vp.
  Record view_args_inv (gsA' gsA : list carg) (vp vs : list domain) : Prop := mk_view_args_inv
    {
One value per argument
      view_args_inv_len : List.length vs = List.length gsA
      
vs is vp at the container's non-recursive positions
    ; view_args_inv_nonrec_c : nonrec_arg_vals gsA' vs = nonrec_arg_vals gsA' vp
      
and at the group's
    ; view_args_inv_nonrec_g : nonrec_arg_vals gsA vs = nonrec_arg_vals gsA vp
      
vs is related at the group's telescope over ups
    ; view_args_inv_grp : per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gsA ++ im_params D Mv)) nil nil (ups ++ ms ++ vs) (ups ++ ms ++ vs)
      
and at the container's over cups
    ; view_args_inv_cnt : per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gsA' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) nil nil (cups ++ ms ++ vs) (cups ++ ms ++ vs)
      
Its non-recursive values are related canonically
    ; view_args_inv_args : tele_prefix_rel (canon_args_rel D ups v ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA))
        (nonrec_arg_vals gsA vs) (nonrec_arg_vals gsA vs) }.

  Lemma tele_args_snoc_entry : forall ts E zs κ G x (i : nat) R b, List.length zs = List.length ts -> per_tele_args ts E E zs zs ->
      ⟦ G ⟧ env_tele E ts zs ↘ b -> DF b ≈ b ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R -> R x x ->
      per_tele_args (ts ++ ce_ass κ G :: nil) E E (zs ++ x :: nil) (zs ++ x :: nil).
  Proof. intros * Hl Hgs Eb HR Hx; eapply per_tele_args_snoc; [ exact Hl | exact Hgs | econstructor; eassumption | exact Hx ]. Qed.

  Lemma view_args_complete : forall gsA gsA' gsB' gsB vp, gs' = gsA' ++ gsB' -> gs = gsA ++ gsB -> cargs_correspond vm gsA' gsA ->
      List.length vp = List.length gsA ->
      tele_prefix_rel (canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA'))
        (nonrec_arg_vals gsA' vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gsA' vp) ->
      exists vs, view_args_inv gsA' gsA vp vs.
  Proof.
    pose proof view_nn as Hnn.
    induction gsA as [| g gsA IH] using List.rev_ind; intros gsA' gsB' gsB vp Heq' Heq Hc Hlp Hpre.
    - destruct gsA' as [| g' gsA']; [| destruct g'; cbn in Hc; contradiction ].
      destruct vp; [| discriminate ].
      exists nil; constructor; cbn [List.length nonrec_arg_vals cargs_nonrec]; try reflexivity.
      + unfold cargs_ctx; cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app]; rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hms_g.
      + unfold cargs_ctx; cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app]; rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hms_c.
      + rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ reflexivity |] ]; intros [|] ? ? H; discriminate.
    - pose proof (cargs_correspond_len _ _ _ Hc) as HlA; rewrite List.length_app in HlA; cbn in HlA.
      destruct (List.exists_last (l := gsA') ltac:(intros ->; cbn in HlA; lia)) as (gsA0' & g' & ->).
      rewrite List.length_app in HlA; cbn in HlA.
      destruct (cargs_correspond_split _ _ _ _ _ Hc ltac:(lia)) as [Hc0 Hc1].
      rewrite List.length_app in Hlp; cbn in Hlp.
      destruct (List.exists_last (l := vp) ltac:(intros ->; cbn in Hlp; lia)) as (vp0 & x & ->).
      rewrite List.length_app in Hlp; cbn in Hlp.
      rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Heq', Heq; cbn [List.app] in Heq', Heq.
      assert (Hlc0 : List.length vp0 = List.length gsA0') by lia.
      rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, nonrec_arg_vals_app in Hpre by exact Hlc0.
      assert (HK0 : List.length (nonrec_arg_vals gsA0' vp0) = List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA0'))
        by exact (length_nonrec_arg_vals _ _ Hlc0).
      assert (Hpre0 : tele_prefix_rel (canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA0'))
                        (nonrec_arg_vals gsA0' vp0) (nonrec_arg_vals gsA0' vp0)).
      { pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_of_pre _ _ _ _ (List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA0')) Hpre ltac:(rewrite List.length_app; lia)) as H.
        rewrite !firstn_app_exact in H by exact HK0; exact H. }
      destruct (IH gsA0' (g' :: gsB') (g :: gsB) vp0 Heq' Heq Hc0 ltac:(lia) Hpre0) as [vs0 [Hl0 Hn0 Hn0g Hg0 Hcn0 Ha0]].
      pose proof (cargs_ctx_snoc qc Dq Mi' gsA0' g') as ECc; pose proof (cargs_ctx_snoc p D Mv gsA g) as ECg.
      assert (Hl0' : List.length vs0 = List.length gsA0') by lia.
      assert (HlU : List.length (ups ++ ms ++ vs0) = List.length (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gsA ++ im_params D Mv)))
        by (rewrite List.length_rev, !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia).
      assert (HlC : List.length (cups ++ ms ++ vs0) = List.length (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gsA0' ++ im_params Dq Mi')))
        by (rewrite List.length_rev, !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params, length_container_uparams; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia).
      destruct g' as [rA' A' | t'], g as [rA A | t]; cbn in Hc1; try contradiction; cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app] in ECc, ECg.
      +
Non-recursive in both.
        pose proof (view_arg_link gsA0' _ gsB' gsA _ gsB _ _ _ _ vs0 Heq' Heq ltac:(lia) Hl0 ECc ECg Hg0 Hcn0)
          as HL;
          pose proof (heads_agree _ _ _ _ HL) as EL;
          destruct (group_type_value _ _ _ _ HL) as (ig & Rg & bg & Ebg & HRg & Hnbg);
          destruct (container_type_value _ _ _ _ HL) as (ic & Rc & ac & Eac & HRc).
        destruct (valid_group_arg_head qc Dq HgQ HcvQ i' Mi' c gs' gsA0' rA' A' gsB' cups ms vs0 HMi' Hcon' Heq' length_container_uparams ltac:(lia) Hl0' Hcn0)
          as (i1 & R1 & a1 & Ea1 & HR1 & E1).
        destruct (valid_group_arg_head p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs gsA rA A gsB ups ms vs0 HMv Hcon Heq Hu Hlms Hl0 Hg0)
          as (i2 & R2 & a2 & Ea2 & HR2 & E2).
        pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Ea1 Eac) as <-; pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Ea2 Ebg) as <-.
        assert (Hxc : canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c (List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA0')) (nonrec_arg_vals gsA0' vs0) x x).
        { rewrite Hn0; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hpre; destruct Hpre as (_ & _ & Hr).
          cbn [nonrec_arg_vals] in Hr.
          assert (Ex : List.nth_error (nonrec_arg_vals gsA0' vp0 ++ x :: nil) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA0')) = Some x)
            by (rewrite List.nth_error_app2, HK0, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
          pose proof (Hr _ _ _ Ex Ex) as H; rewrite firstn_app_exact in H by exact HK0; exact H. }
        assert (Hx1 : R1 x x) by (apply E1; exact Hxc).
        assert (Hxg : per_head (A[wk_pat (cargs_pat gsA)]ʷ) (A[wk_pat (cargs_pat gsA)]ʷ)
                        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gsA ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs0))
                        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gsA ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs0)) x x)
          by (apply EL, (per_head_left Ea1 Ea1 HR1); exact Hx1).
        exists (vs0 ++ x :: nil); constructor.
        * rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia.
        * rewrite !nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals]; rewrite Hn0; reflexivity.
        * rewrite !nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals]; rewrite Hn0g; reflexivity.
        * rewrite ECg; cbn [List.app List.rev]; rewrite (List.app_assoc ms vs0), (List.app_assoc ups (ms ++ vs0)).
          exact (tele_args_snoc_entry _ _ _ _ _ x _ _ _ HlU Hg0 Ea2 HR2 (proj2 (per_head_left Ea2 Ea2 HR2 _ _) Hxg)).
        * rewrite ECc; cbn [List.app List.rev]; rewrite (List.app_assoc ms vs0), (List.app_assoc cups (ms ++ vs0)).
          exact (tele_args_snoc_entry _ _ _ _ _ x _ _ _ HlC Hcn0 Ea1 HR1 Hx1).
        * rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [cargs_nonrec nonrec_arg_vals]; rewrite List.length_app.
          cbn [List.length]; rewrite Nat.add_1_r.
          apply tele_prefix_rel_snoc; [ exact Ha0 |].
          apply E2; apply (per_head_left Ea2 Ea2 HR2); exact Hxg.
      +
Non-recursive in the container, recursive in the group: the view nests through it.
        pose proof (view_arg_link gsA0' _ gsB' gsA _ gsB _ _ _ _ vs0 Heq' Heq ltac:(lia) Hl0 ECc ECg Hg0 Hcn0)
          as HL;
          pose proof (heads_agree _ _ _ _ HL) as EL;
          destruct (group_type_value _ _ _ _ HL) as (ig & Rg & bg & Ebg & HRg & Hnbg);
          destruct (container_type_value _ _ _ _ HL) as (ic & Rc & ac & Eac & HRc).
        destruct (valid_group_arg_head qc Dq HgQ HcvQ i' Mi' c gs' gsA0' rA' A' gsB' cups ms vs0 HMi' Hcon' Heq' length_container_uparams ltac:(lia) Hl0' Hcn0)
          as (i1 & R1 & a1 & Ea1 & HR1 & E1).
        pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Ea1 Eac) as <-.
        assert (Hxc : canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c (List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA0')) (nonrec_arg_vals gsA0' vs0) x x).
        { rewrite Hn0; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hpre; destruct Hpre as (_ & _ & Hr).
          cbn [nonrec_arg_vals] in Hr.
          assert (Ex : List.nth_error (nonrec_arg_vals gsA0' vp0 ++ x :: nil) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gsA0')) = Some x)
            by (rewrite List.nth_error_app2, HK0, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
          pose proof (Hr _ _ _ Ex Ex) as H; rewrite firstn_app_exact in H by exact HK0; exact H. }
        assert (Hx1 : R1 x x) by (apply E1; exact Hxc).
        assert (Hxg : Rg x x) by (apply (per_head_left Ebg Ebg HRg), EL, (per_head_left Ea1 Ea1 HR1); exact Hx1).
        exists (vs0 ++ x :: nil); constructor.
        * rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia.
        * rewrite !nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals]; rewrite Hn0; reflexivity.
        * rewrite !nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals]; rewrite Hn0g; reflexivity.
        * rewrite ECg; cbn [List.app List.rev]; rewrite (List.app_assoc ms vs0), (List.app_assoc ups (ms ++ vs0)).
          exact (tele_args_snoc_entry _ _ _ _ _ x _ _ _ HlU Hg0 Ebg HRg Hxg).
        * rewrite ECc; cbn [List.app List.rev]; rewrite (List.app_assoc ms vs0), (List.app_assoc cups (ms ++ vs0)).
          exact (tele_args_snoc_entry _ _ _ _ _ x _ _ _ HlC Hcn0 Ea1 HR1 Hx1).
        * rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [cargs_nonrec nonrec_arg_vals].
          rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact Ha0.
      +
Recursive in both: a fresh variable.
        pose proof (view_arg_link gsA0' _ gsB' gsA _ gsB _ _ _ _ vs0 Heq' Heq ltac:(lia) Hl0 ECc ECg Hg0 Hcn0)
          as HL;
          pose proof (heads_agree _ _ _ _ HL) as EL;
          destruct (group_type_value _ _ _ _ HL) as (ig & Rg & bg & Ebg & HRg & Hnbg);
          destruct (container_type_value _ _ _ _ HL) as (ic & Rc & ac & Eac & HRc).
        set (y := ⇑! bg 0).
        assert (Hyg : Rg y y) by exact (var_per_elem 0 HRg Hnbg).
        assert (Hyc : Rc y y) by (apply (per_head_left Eac Eac HRc), EL, (per_head_left Ebg Ebg HRg); exact Hyg).
        exists (vs0 ++ y :: nil); constructor.
        * rewrite !List.length_app; cbn; lia.
        * rewrite !nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals]; rewrite Hn0; reflexivity.
        * rewrite !nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals]; rewrite Hn0g; reflexivity.
        * rewrite ECg; cbn [List.app List.rev]; rewrite (List.app_assoc ms vs0), (List.app_assoc ups (ms ++ vs0)).
          exact (tele_args_snoc_entry _ _ _ _ _ y _ _ _ HlU Hg0 Ebg HRg Hyg).
        * rewrite ECc; cbn [List.app List.rev]; rewrite (List.app_assoc ms vs0), (List.app_assoc cups (ms ++ vs0)).
          exact (tele_args_snoc_entry _ _ _ _ _ y _ _ _ HlC Hcn0 Eac HRc Hyc).
        * rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, nonrec_arg_vals_app by lia; cbn [cargs_nonrec nonrec_arg_vals].
          rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact Ha0.

An Argument the View Nests Through

Non-recursive in the container, of a shape t in the group: the container's canonical relation of the argument is the group's relation of the shape, given the relation of the type of the member the shape ends in (view_end_rel).
  Lemma nested_arg_rel_agree : forall gs1' rA' A' gs2' gs1 t gs2 vp, gs' = gs1' ++ ca_arg rA' A' :: gs2' -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
      cargs_correspond vm gs1' gs1 -> List.length vp = List.length gs1 ->
      tele_prefix_rel (canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1'))
        (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) ->
      tele_rel (canon_nparams_rel D ups v) (List.rev (im_nparams Mv)) ms ms ->
      view_end_rel p D ups ups (ptyp_mem t) -> rview_end_rel p D ups ups (ptyp_mem t) ->
      (canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1')) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp)
         <~> rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups (canon_nparams_rel D ups)) (canon_nparams_rel D ups) (canon_args_rel D ups)
               (canon_doms_rel D ups) v ups ups (ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp) (ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp)
               (List.rev (im_nparams Mv) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) t).
  Proof.
    intros * Heq' Heq Hc Hlp Hpre Hnsd Hend Hrend.
    pose proof view_nn as Hnn.
    pose proof (cargs_correspond_len _ _ _ Hc) as Hl1.
    destruct (view_args_complete gs1 gs1' (ca_arg rA' A' :: gs2') (ca_rec t :: gs2) vp Heq' Heq Hc Hlp Hpre)
      as (vs & [Hl Hn Hng Hg1 Hcn Ha]).
    pose proof (cargs_ctx_snoc qc Dq Mi' gs1' (ca_arg rA' A')) as ECc; pose proof (cargs_ctx_snoc p D Mv gs1 (ca_rec t)) as ECg.
    cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app] in ECc, ECg.
    pose proof (view_arg_link gs1' _ gs2' gs1 _ gs2 _ _ _ _ vs Heq' Heq ltac:(lia) Hl ECc ECg Hg1 Hcn)
      as HL;
          pose proof (heads_agree _ _ _ _ HL) as EL;
          destruct (group_type_value _ _ _ _ HL) as (ig & Rg & bg & Ebg & HRg & Hnbg);
          destruct (container_type_value _ _ _ _ HL) as (ic & Rc & ac & Eac & HRc).
    destruct (valid_group_arg_head qc Dq HgQ HcvQ i' Mi' c gs' gs1' rA' A' gs2' cups ms vs HMi' Hcon' Heq' length_container_uparams ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia) Hcn)
      as (i1 & R1 & a1 & Ea1 & HR1 & E1).
    pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Ea1 Eac) as <-.
The group's side: the shape's relation, by shape_char.
    pose proof (valid_group_cargs_sem p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs HMv Hcon) as HΨ.
    destruct (valid_group_cargs_sem_all p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs HMv Hcon gs1 (ca_rec t :: gs2) Heq) as [HW1 _].
    assert (HpreR : forall R, EF cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv ≈ cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R ->
                      R (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs))
                        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs))).
    { intros R HR; apply (tele_args_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HR HW1); [| exact Hg1 ].
      rewrite !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia. }
    assert (Hy0 : tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (canon_doms_rel D ups v) (List.rev (im_nparams Mv)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1)
                                     ms (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vs) t) 0 nil nil)
      by (rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ reflexivity |] ]; intros [|] ? ? H; discriminate).
    assert (Hgy0 : per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn 0 (ptyp_doms t))))
                     (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs))
                     (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs)) nil nil) by (cbn; constructor).
    pose proof (shape_char p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs HMv Hcon HΨ gs1 t gs2 Heq ups ms vs Hu Hlms Hl Hgu Hnsd Ha HpreR Hend Hrend
                  (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) 0 nil bg ig Rg eq_refl Hy0 Hgy0 Ebg HRg) as Hsh.
    cbn [ptyp_skip List.firstn] in Hsh; rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Hsh.
    rewrite <- Hn, <- Hng.
    intros x y; split; intro Hxy.
    - apply Hsh, (per_head_left Ebg Ebg HRg), EL, (per_head_left Ea1 Ea1 HR1), E1; exact Hxy.
    - apply E1, (per_head_left Ea1 Ea1 HR1), EL, (per_head_left Ebg Ebg HRg), Hsh; exact Hxy.
  Qed.

An Argument Non-Recursive in Both

The container's canonical relation of the argument is the group's.
  Lemma view_arg_rel : forall gs1' rA' A' gs2' gs1 rA A gs2 vp, gs' = gs1' ++ ca_arg rA' A' :: gs2' -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_arg rA A :: gs2 ->
      cargs_correspond vm gs1' gs1 -> List.length vp = List.length gs1 ->
      tele_prefix_rel (canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1'))
        (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) ->
      (canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1')) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp)
         <~> canon_args_rel D ups v ms c (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp)).
  Proof.
    intros * Heq' Heq Hc Hlp Hpre.
    pose proof view_nn as Hnn.
    pose proof (cargs_correspond_len _ _ _ Hc) as Hl1.
    destruct (view_args_complete gs1 gs1' (ca_arg rA' A' :: gs2') (ca_arg rA A :: gs2) vp Heq' Heq Hc Hlp Hpre)
      as (vs & [Hl Hn Hng Hg1 Hcn Ha]).
    pose proof (cargs_ctx_snoc qc Dq Mi' gs1' (ca_arg rA' A')) as ECc; pose proof (cargs_ctx_snoc p D Mv gs1 (ca_arg rA A)) as ECg.
    cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app] in ECc, ECg.
    pose proof (view_arg_link gs1' _ gs2' gs1 _ gs2 _ _ _ _ vs Heq' Heq ltac:(lia) Hl ECc ECg Hg1 Hcn) as HL; pose proof (heads_agree _ _ _ _ HL) as EL.
    destruct (valid_group_arg_head qc Dq HgQ HcvQ i' Mi' c gs' gs1' rA' A' gs2' cups ms vs HMi' Hcon' Heq' length_container_uparams ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia) Hcn)
      as (i1 & R1 & a1 & Ea1 & HR1 & E1).
    destruct (valid_group_arg_head p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs gs1 rA A gs2 ups ms vs HMv Hcon Heq Hu Hlms Hl Hg1)
      as (i2 & R2 & a2 & Ea2 & HR2 & E2).
    rewrite <- Hn, <- Hng.
    intros x y; split; intro Hxy.
    - apply E2, (per_head_left Ea2 Ea2 HR2), EL, (per_head_left Ea1 Ea1 HR1), E1; exact Hxy.
    - apply E1, (per_head_left Ea1 Ea1 HR1), EL, (per_head_left Ea2 Ea2 HR2), E2; exact Hxy.
  Qed.

An Argument Recursive in Both: its Shape, Domain by Domain

Through the domains of the two shapes: after kk domains ys related at both telescopes of domains, the types of the rests of the shapes are related to each other.
  Record shape_walk_state (gs1' gs1 : list carg) (t' t : ptyp) (vs : list domain) (kk : nat) (ys : list domain) : Prop :=
    mk_shape_walk_state
    {
ys is related at the group shape's first kk domains
      walk_group_doms : per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t))))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs)) ys ys
      
and at the container shape's
    ; walk_container_doms : per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t'))))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) (cups ++ ms ++ vs))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) (cups ++ ms ++ vs)) ys ys
      
The types of the rests of the two shapes are related
    ; walk_types_related : exists (i : nat) R ag ac,
        ⟦ ptyp_ty p D (im_nn Mv) (List.repeat false kk ++ cargs_pat gs1) (ptyp_skip kk t) ⟧
          env_tele nil (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv))
            (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) ↘ ag /\
        ⟦ ptyp_ty qc Dq (im_nn Mi') (List.repeat false kk ++ cargs_pat gs1') (ptyp_skip kk t') ⟧
          env_tele nil (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t')) ++ cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi'))
            (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) ↘ ac /\
        DF ag ≈ ac ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R }.

  Lemma view_shape_walk : forall gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 vp vs, gs' = gs1' ++ ca_rec t' :: gs2' -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
      cargs_correspond vm gs1' gs1 -> view_args_inv gs1' gs1 vp vs ->
      forall kk ys, kk <= List.length (ptyp_doms t) ->
        tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (canon_doms_rel Dq cups i') (List.rev (im_nparams Mi')) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1')
                           ms (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) t') kk ys ys ->
        shape_walk_state gs1' gs1 t' t vs kk ys.
  Proof.
    intros gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 vp vs Heq' Heq Hc [Hl Hn Hng Hg1 Hcn Ha].
    pose proof view_nn as Hnn.
    pose proof (cargs_correspond_len _ _ _ Hc) as Hl1.
    assert (HlD : List.length (ptyp_doms t') = List.length (ptyp_doms t)).
    { rewrite Heq', Heq in Hcorr; destruct (cargs_correspond_split _ _ _ _ _ Hcorr ltac:(lia)) as [_ H].
      cbn in H; destruct H as (_ & Hd & _); unfold ptyp_depth in Hd; exact Hd. }
    set (EAg := env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs)).
    set (EAc := env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) (cups ++ ms ++ vs)).
    assert (HlAg : List.length (ups ++ ms ++ vs) = List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv))
      by (rewrite !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia).
    assert (HlAc : List.length (cups ++ ms ++ vs) = List.length (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi'))
      by (rewrite !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params, length_container_uparams; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia).
The environments after the domains, over the arguments' or closed.
    assert (HEg : forall kk ys, env_tele EAg (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t)))) ys
                                = env_tele nil (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv))
                                    (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys)).
    { intros kk ys; unfold EAg.
      replace (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) with ((ups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      rewrite (env_tele_closed_app (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv) _ (ups ++ ms ++ vs) ys) by exact HlAg; reflexivity. }
    assert (HEc : forall kk ys, env_tele EAc (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t')))) ys
                                = env_tele nil (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t')) ++ cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi'))
                                    (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys)).
    { intros kk ys; unfold EAc.
      replace (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) with ((cups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      rewrite (env_tele_closed_app (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi') _ (cups ++ ms ++ vs) ys) by exact HlAc; reflexivity. }
    assert (Hgp : forall kk ys, per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t)))) EAg EAg ys ys ->
                  per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv))
                    nil nil (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys)).
    { intros kk ys H; rewrite List.rev_app_distr.
      replace (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) with ((ups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      apply per_tele_args_app_intro; [| exact Hg1 | exact H ].
      rewrite List.length_rev, !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia. }
    assert (Hcp : forall kk ys, per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t')))) EAc EAc ys ys ->
                  per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t')) ++ cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi'))
                    nil nil (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys)).
    { intros kk ys H; rewrite List.rev_app_distr.
      replace (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) with ((cups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      apply per_tele_args_app_intro; [| exact Hcn | exact H ].
      rewrite List.length_rev, !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params, length_container_uparams; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia. }
    induction kk as [| kk IH]; intros ys Hk Hy.
    - destruct ys as [| y0 ys]; [| rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hy; destruct Hy as [Hy _]; discriminate ].
      pose proof (cargs_ctx_snoc qc Dq Mi' gs1' (ca_rec t')) as ECc; pose proof (cargs_ctx_snoc p D Mv gs1 (ca_rec t)) as ECg.
      cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app] in ECc, ECg.
      pose proof (view_arg_link gs1' _ gs2' gs1 _ gs2 _ _ _ _ vs Heq' Heq ltac:(lia) Hl ECc ECg Hg1 Hcn) as HL.
      destruct (group_container_types_related _ _ _ _ HL) as (i & R & ag & ac & Eag & Eac & HR).
      constructor; [ cbn; constructor | cbn; constructor |].
      exists i, R, ag, ac; rewrite !List.app_nil_r; cbn [List.repeat List.app ptyp_skip].
      split; [ exact Eag | split; [ exact Eac | exact HR ] ].
    - destruct (List.exists_last (l := ys) ltac:(intros ->; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hy; destruct Hy as [Hy _]; discriminate))
        as (ys0 & y & ->).
      pose proof Hy as Hyl; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hyl; destruct Hyl as (Hly & _ & Hyr).
      rewrite List.length_app in Hly; cbn in Hly.
      assert (Hly0 : List.length ys0 = kk) by lia.
      assert (Hy0 : tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (canon_doms_rel Dq cups i') (List.rev (im_nparams Mi')) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1')
                                       ms (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) t') kk ys0 ys0).
      { pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_of_pre _ _ _ _ kk Hy ltac:(lia)) as H.
        rewrite !firstn_app_exact in H by exact Hly0; exact H. }
      destruct (IH ys0 ltac:(lia) Hy0) as [Hgd Hcd (i & R & ag & ac & Eag & Eac & HR)].
      destruct (ptyp_skip_lt kk t ltac:(lia)) as (B & HB & Hs).
      destruct (ptyp_skip_lt kk t' ltac:(lia)) as (B' & HB' & Hs').
      destruct (valid_group_dom_head p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs gs1 t gs2 kk B ups ms vs ys0 HMv Hcon Heq HB Hu Hlms Hl Hly0 (Hgp _ _ Hgd))
        as (ig & Rg & bg & Ebg & HRg & Eg).
      destruct (valid_group_dom_head qc Dq HgQ HcvQ i' Mi' c gs' gs1' t' gs2' kk B' cups ms vs ys0 HMi' Hcon' Heq' HB' length_container_uparams
                  ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia) Hly0 (Hcp _ _ Hcd)) as (ic & Rc & bc & Ebc & HRc & Ec).
      rewrite Hs in Eag; rewrite Hs' in Eac; cbn [ptyp_ty] in Eag, Eac.
      set (Egk := env_tele nil (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv))
                    (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys0)) in *.
      set (Eck := env_tele nil (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t')) ++ cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi'))
                    (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys0)) in *.
      assert (Ag : ag = Πᵈ{ak_relevant} bg Egk (ptyp_ty p D (im_nn Mv) (false :: List.repeat false kk ++ cargs_pat gs1) (ptyp_skip (S kk) t)))
        by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Eag | econstructor; exact Ebg ]).
      assert (Ac : ac = Πᵈ{ak_relevant} bc Eck (ptyp_ty qc Dq (im_nn Mi') (false :: List.repeat false kk ++ cargs_pat gs1') (ptyp_skip (S kk) t')))
        by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Eac | econstructor; exact Ebc ]).
      subst ag ac; clear Eag Eac.
      basic_invert_per_univ_elem HR.
      match goal with H : per_univ_elem _ ?r bg bc |- _ => rename H into Hin; set (Rin := r) in * end.
      match goal with H : forall c c' (_ : Rin c c'), rel_mod_eval _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename H into Hcod end.
      assert (Hyc : canon_doms_rel Dq cups i' (ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vs ++ ys0)
                      (List.rev (im_nparams Mi') ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1' ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t')) B' y y).
      { assert (Ex : List.nth_error (ys0 ++ y :: nil) kk = Some y)
          by (rewrite List.nth_error_app2, Hly0, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
        pose proof (Hyr _ _ _ Ex Ex) as Hx; rewrite firstn_app_exact in Hx by exact Hly0.
        unfold shape_doms_rel in Hx; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HB') in Hx; rewrite Hn; exact Hx. }
      assert (Hyin : Rin y y)
        by (apply (per_univ_elem_left_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRc Hin), Ec; exact Hyc).
      assert (Hyg : Rg y y) by (apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRg Hin); exact Hyin).
      assert (Hyc' : Rc y y) by (apply Ec; exact Hyc).
      destruct (Hcod y y Hyin) as [a2 a2' Ea2 Ea2' HR2].
The rests of the shapes at the telescopes' extensions.
      assert (HgW : per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv))
                      nil nil ((ups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys0) ((ups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys0))
        by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact (Hgp _ _ Hgd)).
      assert (HcW : per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t')) ++ cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi'))
                      nil nil ((cups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys0) ((cups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys0))
        by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact (Hcp _ _ Hcd)).
      pose proof (valid_group_cargs_sem p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs HMv Hcon) as HΨg.
      pose proof (valid_group_cargs_sem qc Dq HgQ HcvQ i' Mi' c gs' HMi' Hcon') as HΨc.
      destruct (shape_codomain_tele p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs HMv Hcon HΨg gs1 t gs2 Heq (ups ++ ms ++ vs) ys0 kk B HlAg Hly0 HB HgW
                  ig bg Rg ltac:(rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ebg) HRg y a2 Hyg
                  ltac:(rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ea2)) as (j1 & R1 & b2 & Eb2 & HR1).
      destruct (shape_codomain_tele qc Dq HgQ HcvQ i' Mi' c gs' HMi' Hcon' HΨc gs1' t' gs2' Heq' (cups ++ ms ++ vs) ys0 kk B' HlAc ltac:(lia) HB' HcW
                  ic bc Rc ltac:(rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ebc) HRc y a2' Hyc'
                  ltac:(rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ea2')) as (j2 & R2 & b2' & Eb2' & HR2').
      constructor.
      + rewrite (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ HB), shape_domains_ctx_snoc, List.length_firstn, Nat.min_l by lia.
        cbn [List.rev].
        apply (per_tele_args_snoc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ig Rg); [ rewrite List.length_rev, length_shape_domains_ctx, List.length_firstn; lia | exact Hgd | | exact Hyg ].
        rewrite HEg; fold Egk.
        econstructor; [ exact Ebg | exact Ebg | exact HRg ].
      + rewrite (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ HB'), shape_domains_ctx_snoc, List.length_firstn, Nat.min_l by lia.
        cbn [List.rev].
        apply (per_tele_args_snoc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ic Rc); [ rewrite List.length_rev, length_shape_domains_ctx, List.length_firstn; lia | exact Hcd | | exact Hyc' ].
        rewrite HEc; fold Eck.
        econstructor; [ exact Ebc | exact Ebc | exact HRc ].
      + destruct (per_univ_trans' _ _ _ _ _ ltac:(eexists; exact (per_univ_sym _ _ _ _ HR1)) ltac:(eexists; exact HR2)) as [R3 HR3].
        destruct (per_univ_trans' _ _ _ _ _ ltac:(eexists; exact HR3) ltac:(eexists; exact HR2')) as [R4 HR4].
        exists j1, R4, b2, b2'.
        rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in Eb2, Eb2'.
        split; [ exact Eb2 | split; [ exact Eb2' | exact HR4 ] ].
  Qed.

  Lemma walk_group_prefix : forall gs1 t vs kk ys, List.length vs = List.length gs1 ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) nil nil (ups ++ ms ++ vs) (ups ++ ms ++ vs) ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t))))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (ups ++ ms ++ vs)) ys ys ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv))
        nil nil (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys).
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hg1 H; rewrite List.rev_app_distr.
    replace (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) with ((ups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
    apply per_tele_args_app_intro; [| exact Hg1 | exact H ].
    rewrite List.length_rev, !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia.
  Qed.

  Lemma walk_container_prefix : forall gs1' t' vs kk ys, List.length vs = List.length gs1' ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) nil nil (cups ++ ms ++ vs) (cups ++ ms ++ vs) ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t'))))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) (cups ++ ms ++ vs))
        (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi')) (cups ++ ms ++ vs)) ys ys ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn kk (ptyp_doms t')) ++ cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi'))
        nil nil (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys).
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hcn H; pose proof view_nn as Hnn; rewrite List.rev_app_distr.
    replace (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys) with ((cups ++ ms ++ vs) ++ ys) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
    apply per_tele_args_app_intro; [| exact Hcn | exact H ].
    rewrite List.length_rev, !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params, length_container_uparams; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia.
  Qed.

An argument recursive in both: the domains of the shapes (agree_shape_doms_rel at the canonical relations).
  Lemma shape_doms_rel_agree : forall gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 vp d B' B ys,
      gs' = gs1' ++ ca_rec t' :: gs2' -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> cargs_correspond vm gs1' gs1 -> List.length vp = List.length gs1 ->
      tele_prefix_rel (canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1'))
        (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) ->
      List.nth_error (ptyp_doms t') d = Some B' -> List.nth_error (ptyp_doms t) d = Some B ->
      tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (canon_doms_rel Dq cups i') (List.rev (im_nparams Mi')) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1')
                         ms (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) t') d ys ys ->
      (canon_doms_rel Dq cups i' (ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp ++ ys)
         (List.rev (im_nparams Mi') ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1' ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t')) B'
       <~> canon_doms_rel D ups v (ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp ++ ys)
             (List.rev (im_nparams Mv) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t)) B).
  Proof.
    intros * Heq' Heq Hc Hlp Hpre HB' HB Hy.
    pose proof view_nn as Hnn.
    pose proof (cargs_correspond_len _ _ _ Hc) as Hl1.
    destruct (view_args_complete gs1 gs1' (ca_rec t' :: gs2') (ca_rec t :: gs2) vp Heq' Heq Hc Hlp Hpre) as (vs & Hinv).
    pose proof Hinv as [Hl Hn Hng Hg1 Hcn _].
    assert (Hd : d < List.length (ptyp_doms t)) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
    assert (Hd' : d < List.length (ptyp_doms t')) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
    destruct (view_shape_walk gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 vp vs Heq' Heq Hc Hinv d ys ltac:(lia) Hy)
      as [Hgd Hcd (i & R & ag & ac & Eag & Eac & HR)].
    pose proof Hy as Hyl; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hyl; destruct Hyl as (Hly & _ & _).
    destruct (valid_group_dom_head p D Hg Hcv v Mv c gs gs1 t gs2 d B ups ms vs ys HMv Hcon Heq HB Hu Hlms Hl Hly
                (walk_group_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hl Hg1 Hgd)) as (ig & Rg & bg & Ebg & HRg & Eg).
    destruct (valid_group_dom_head qc Dq HgQ HcvQ i' Mi' c gs' gs1' t' gs2' d B' cups ms vs ys HMi' Hcon' Heq' HB' length_container_uparams
                ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia) Hly (walk_container_prefix gs1' t' vs d ys ltac:(lia) Hcn Hcd)) as (ic & Rc & bc & Ebc & HRc & Ec).
    destruct (ptyp_skip_lt d t Hd) as (B0 & HB0 & Hs); rewrite HB in HB0; injection HB0 as <-.
    destruct (ptyp_skip_lt d t' Hd') as (B0' & HB0' & Hs'); rewrite HB' in HB0'; injection HB0' as <-.
    rewrite Hs in Eag; rewrite Hs' in Eac; cbn [ptyp_ty] in Eag, Eac.
    assert (Ag : ag = Πᵈ{ak_relevant} bg (env_tele nil (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn d (ptyp_doms t)) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mv gs1 ++ im_params D Mv))
                               (ups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys))
                        (ptyp_ty p D (im_nn Mv) (false :: List.repeat false d ++ cargs_pat gs1) (ptyp_skip (S d) t)))
      by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Eag | econstructor; exact Ebg ]).
    assert (Ac : ac = Πᵈ{ak_relevant} bc (env_tele nil (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1') (List.firstn d (ptyp_doms t')) ++ cargs_ctx qc Dq Mi' gs1' ++ im_params Dq Mi'))
                               (cups ++ ms ++ vs ++ ys))
                        (ptyp_ty qc Dq (im_nn Mi') (false :: List.repeat false d ++ cargs_pat gs1') (ptyp_skip (S d) t')))
      by (eapply functional_eval_exp; [ exact Eac | econstructor; exact Ebc ]).
    subst ag ac; clear Eag Eac.
    basic_invert_per_univ_elem HR.
    match goal with H : per_univ_elem _ ?r bg bc |- _ => rename H into Hin end.
    rewrite <- Hn, <- Hng.
    etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact Ec |].
    etransitivity; [ exact (per_univ_elem_left_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRc Hin) |].
    etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRg Hin) | exact Eg ].
  Qed.

The Non-Uniform Parameters

The container's canonical relation of a non-uniform parameter at cups is the group's at ups of the member the view takes the container's to (agree_nparams_rel at the canonical relations).
  Lemma view_nparams_rel : forall j vs vs', j < im_nn Mi' -> tele_prefix_rel (canon_nparams_rel Dq cups i') j vs vs' ->
      (canon_nparams_rel Dq cups i' j vs <~> canon_nparams_rel D ups v j vs).
  Proof.
    clear Hms_g Hms_c Hlms ms.
    intros j vs vs' Hj Hp.
    pose proof view_nn as Hnn.
    pose proof (valid_group_valid _ _ Hg) as HD; pose proof (valid_group_closed _ _ Hg) as Hc.
    pose proof (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) as HDQ; pose proof (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) as HcQ; pose proof (valid_group_sort _ _ HgQ) as HsuQ.
    destruct (valid_group_canon qc Dq HgQ cups view_container_uparams_rel length_container_uparams) as [CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI].
    set (tc := List.rev (im_nparams Mi')); set (tg := List.rev (im_nparams Mv)).
    assert (Hlr : j <= List.length tc) by (unfold tc; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams; lia).
    assert (Hlv : List.length vs = j) by (rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hp; tauto).
    pose proof (tele_prefix_rel_refl_l (List.length tc) _
                  (fun k0 a b Hk Ha => nparams_rel_per qc Dq cups _ _ _ (valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ) CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI i' Mi' HMi' k0 a b Hk Ha)
                  (fun k0 a b Hk Ha => nparams_rel_invariant qc Dq cups _ _ _ (valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ) CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI i' Mi' HMi' k0 a b Hk Ha)
                  j vs vs' Hlr Hp) as Hpp.
    destruct (sort_value Dq HDQ cups view_container_uparams_rel length_container_uparams) as [aQ EaQ].
    pose proof (nr_tele_args Dq HDQ HcQ HsuQ i' Mi' HMi' cups cups aQ view_container_uparams_rel length_container_uparams EaQ j vs vs ltac:(lia) Hpp) as Hg0.
The container's telescope, from no base to the instance's.
    pose proof (valid_ind_decl_uparams _ HDQ) as HUQ.
    destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HUQ) as [RQ HRQ].
    assert (Hlc : List.length cups = List.length (ind_uparams Dq)) by (rewrite length_container_uparams; reflexivity).
    set (EU := decl_env D ups).
    set (Ecq := components_env D ups (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)) cups).
    destruct (closed_tele_base_rel (ind_uparams Dq) RQ EU EU cups (decl_closed_ass _ HcQ) HUQ HRQ view_container_uparams_rel Hlc)
      as [HQ1 _].
    change (env_tele EU (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)) cups) with Ecq in HQ1.
    change (env_tele nil (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)) cups) with (decl_env Dq cups) in HQ1.
    assert (Hac : all_assumptions tc) by exact (List.Forall_rev (member_nparams_ass Dq HcQ _ _ HMi')).
    assert (Hag : all_assumptions tg) by exact (List.Forall_rev (member_nparams_ass D Hc _ _ HMv)).
    assert (HWc0 : ⊨ List.rev tc ++ ind_uparams Dq) by (unfold tc; rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact (valid_ind_decl_params _ HDQ _ _ HMi')).
    assert (HTc0 : forall j0 κ A, List.nth_error tc j0 = Some (ce_ass κ A) ->
                     exists i : nat, List.rev (List.firstn j0 tc) ++ ind_uparams Dq ⊨ A : Typeω@i)
      by (intros j0 κ A HA; exact (proj2 (valid_ind_decl_nparams _ HDQ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' HA))).
    destruct (tele_base_change tc (ind_uparams Dq) RQ (decl_env Dq cups) Ecq
                Hac HWc0 HTc0 HRQ HQ1 j vs Hlv Hlr Hg0) as [Hg1 Hhd].
The two telescopes, equal under the view's instance.
    pose proof (valid_ind_decl_uparams _ HD) as HUD.
    destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HUD) as [RU HRU].
    pose proof (uparams_rel_env D HD _ _ Hgu Hu _ HRU) as HρU.
    assert (HaC0 : all_assumptions (List.rev tc ++ ind_uparams Dq)) by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply List.Forall_rev; exact Hac | exact (decl_closed_ass _ HcQ) ]).
    assert (HWc : ⊨ List.rev tc ++ ind_uparams Dq ++ ind_uparams D)
      by (rewrite List.app_assoc; exact (proj1 (closed_app_sem _ _ HaC0 HWc0 HUD))).
    assert (HTc : forall j0 κ A, List.nth_error tc j0 = Some (ce_ass κ A) ->
                    exists i : nat, List.rev (List.firstn j0 tc) ++ ind_uparams Dq ++ ind_uparams D ⊨ A : Typeω@i).
    { intros j0 κ A HA; destruct (HTc0 _ _ _ HA) as [i HAv].
      assert (Ha0 : all_assumptions (List.rev (List.firstn j0 tc) ++ ind_uparams Dq))
        by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact (all_assumptions_firstn _ _ Hac) | exact (decl_closed_ass _ HcQ) ]).
      exists i; rewrite List.app_assoc; exact (closed_app_valid _ _ _ _ _ Ha0 (rel_ctx_wf_firstn _ _ j0 HWc0) HUD HAv). }
    assert (HWg : ⊨ List.rev tg ++ ind_uparams D) by (unfold tg; rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact (valid_ind_decl_params _ HD _ _ HMv)).
    assert (HTg : forall j0 κ A, List.nth_error tg j0 = Some (ce_ass κ A) ->
                    exists i : nat, List.rev (List.firstn j0 tg) ++ ind_uparams D ⊨ A : Typeω@i)
      by (intros j0 κ A HA; exact (proj2 (valid_ind_decl_nparams _ HD _ _ _ _ _ HMv HA))).
    assert (Heq : ind_uparams D ⊨ˣ tele_sub (List.rev tg) Id ≈ tele_sub (List.rev tc) (sb_of_list Id Is)).
    { unfold tg, tc; rewrite !List.rev_involutive, tele_sub_id.
      exact (valid_group_views_view_nparams p D Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq HMi' Hv HMv). }
    assert (Hlen : List.length tg = List.length tc) by (unfold tg, tc; rewrite !List.length_rev, !length_im_nparams; exact Hnn).
    destruct (gsub_props (valid_group_views_view_args_gsub p D Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq)) as [Hτ _].
    destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_sub_eval p D Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq _ _ Hgu Hu) as (cups0 & Ecups0 & Eτ).
    pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ecups0 Ecups) as ->; fold EU Ecq in Eτ.
    pose proof (@eval_sub_id gc_deps gc_stack (ind_uparams D) EU) as EId.
    unfold EU in EId; rewrite (ctx_retag_decl_env D ups Hu) in EId; fold EU in EId.
    destruct (nth_error_lt_some' tc j ltac:(unfold tc in *; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams; lia)) as [eC HeC].
    destruct (proj1 (List.Forall_forall _ _) Hac eC (List.nth_error_In _ _ HeC)) as (κC & C & ->).
    destruct (nth_error_lt_some' tg j ltac:(unfold tg in *; rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams; lia)) as [eG HeG].
    destruct (proj1 (List.Forall_forall _ _) Hag eG (List.nth_error_In _ _ HeG)) as (κG & G & ->).
    pose proof (tele_link (ind_uparams D) RU EU HRU HρU (ind_uparams D) (ind_uparams Dq ++ ind_uparams D)
                  Id (sb_of_list Id Is) EU Ecq
                  (rel_sub_id (ex_intro _ _ HRU)) Hτ EId Eτ tg tc Hag Hac Hlen HWg HWc HTg HTc Heq
                  j vs κG G κC C Hlv HeG HeC Hg1) as EL.
    unfold canon_nparams_rel, member_nparams; rewrite HMi', HMv; fold tc tg; unfold nth_ctyp; rewrite HeC, HeG.
    unfold components_env; rewrite (env_tele_firstn _ tc vs), (env_tele_firstn _ tg vs), Hlv.
    etransitivity; [ exact (Hhd _ _ HeC) | exact EL ].
  Qed.
End ViewArgs.

An Argument Recursive in Both: the Parameters its Shapes End In

The container's shape ends in its member j', the group's in the member j the view takes j' to; after the domains, the parameters of the two ends are related at j, canonically (agree_shape_params at the canonical relations). Through the ends' types, related by the walk along the domains: at the container's member j' if it is declared (the view j is then of the same instance), else at the declared member both views view, moved to j' by the container's view j'.
Section ViewAgreementParts.
  Variables (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (Hg : valid_group p D) (Hcv : containers_valid D).
  Variables (k : nat) (Mk : imember) (qc : qname) (kc : nat) (Is : list exp) (vm : list nat) (Dq : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HMk : ind_member D k = Some Mk) (Hh : im_head Mk = mh_view qc kc Is vm)
    (Hq : ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some Dq).
  Hypothesis (HcvQ : containers_valid Dq).
  Let HgQ := Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq.
  Variables (ups cups : list domain).
  Hypotheses (Hgu : per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams D)) nil nil ups ups) (Hu : List.length ups = ind_nu D)
    (Ecups : ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D ups ↘ cups).
  Variables (i' : nat) (Mi' : imember) (v : nat) (Mv : imember).
  Hypotheses (HMi' : ind_member Dq i' = Some Mi') (Hv : List.nth_error vm i' = Some v) (HMv : ind_member D v = Some Mv).
  Variables (c : String.string) (gs' gs : list carg).
  Hypotheses (Hcon' : ind_con Mi' c = Some gs') (Hcon : ind_con Mv c = Some gs) (Hcorr : cargs_correspond vm gs' gs).
  Variable (ms : list domain).
  Hypothesis (Hlms : List.length ms = im_nn Mv).
  Hypotheses (Hms_g : per_tele_args (List.rev (im_params D Mv)) nil nil (ups ++ ms) (ups ++ ms))
    (Hms_c : per_tele_args (List.rev (im_params Dq Mi')) nil nil (cups ++ ms) (cups ++ ms)).
  Hypotheses (Hns_g : tele_rel (canon_nparams_rel D ups v) (List.rev (im_nparams Mv)) ms ms)
    (Hns_c : tele_rel (canon_nparams_rel Dq cups i') (List.rev (im_nparams Mi')) ms ms).

  Lemma shape_params_agree : forall gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 vp ys,
      gs' = gs1' ++ ca_rec t' :: gs2' -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> cargs_correspond vm gs1' gs1 -> List.length vp = List.length gs1 ->
      tele_prefix_rel (canon_args_rel Dq cups i' ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1'))
        (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) ->
      tele_rel (shape_doms_rel (canon_doms_rel Dq cups i') (List.rev (im_nparams Mi')) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1') ms (nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp) t')
        (ptyp_doms t') ys ys ->
      ps_link D (canon_nparams_rel D ups) (ptyp_ps t') (ptyp_ps t) (ptyp_mem t)
        (components_env Dq cups (List.rev (im_nparams Mi') ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1' ++ shape_doms_tele t') (ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1' vp ++ ys))
        (components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mv) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ shape_doms_tele t) (ms ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 vp ++ ys)).
  Proof.
    intros gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 vp ys Heq' Heq Hc Hlp Hpre Hys.

      cbn in H; destruct H as (Hm & Hd & _); unfold ptyp_depth in Hd; exact (conj Hm Hd). }

The arguments, related at both telescopes, and the walk along the domains to the ends' types.

Each side's parameters, at the non-recursive arguments and at all the arguments.

    assert (X1 : tele_rel (canon_nparams_rel Dq cups (ptyp_mem t')) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj')) bsC1 bsG1).
    { destruct (im_head Mj') as [pm' | qv kv Is'' vm'' | qr'' Is'' fl''] eqn:Hh';

        assert (HU : ⟦ ind_uvars Dq (im_nn Mi') (List.length (List.repeat false (List.length (ptyp_doms t')) ++ cargs_pat gs1')) ⟧*
                       gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack

        pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ecsc HU) as ->.
